descriptions.zh: 在对§Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§!的扫描中发现在这颗行星最难以靠近的区域有一座孤立的设施。这座结构似乎正在休眠或已被抛弃，其中没有任何能量迹象，看起来也饱经风霜。进行考古发掘可能会带来更深入的洞见。
descriptions.en: Scans of §Y[fromfrom.planet.GetName]§! discovered an isolated facility in the planet's most inaccessible region. The structure appears to be dormant or abandoned, with no energy signature and signs of prolonged weathering. An archaeological expedition may yield further insight.

descriptions.zh: §Y[Planet.GetName]§!上发现了一个硕大无朋的金属立方体。它的外表天衣无缝暗示了先进的技术能力，但我们还无从推测它的起源或功能。考古发掘也许能提供答案。
descriptions.en: A colossal metallic cube has been found on §Y[Planet.GetName]§!. Its seamless form is suggestive of advanced technological capabilities, although we cannot begin to speculate upon its origin or function. An archaeological expedition may provide answers.
